title: Application of Eastern Edison Company, under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, § 94G and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 115, for approval by the Department of a change in the Fuel Charge to be billed to the Company's customers, pursuant to meter readings in the months of June, July and August, 1996. Application is also made for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchase of power pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00. The rules established in 220 C.M.R. 8.00 set forht the filings to be made by utilities with the Department and implement the intent of sections 201 and 210 of the Public Utility Regulatory Policies Act of 1978.
filings: B) ORDER ISSUED Commissioners: Howe, Webster, Besser
